cause: Prime burst fast path scanned command-looking prefixes without consulting CP-retained bytes. A zero Y coordinate at the beginning of a translated 16-byte burst was discarded as GX NOP while scalar writes were queued behind a CP breakpoint.
correction: Prime bursts now use the ordered scalar producer for every byte, including zeroes, blocked CP queues, reentrant consumers and display-list recording. Other game profiles retain their previous fast path.

visual_review.result: No tall white triangles; text now stays in its intended screen region but glyph pixels remain damaged.

earlier_diagnostic_limits: Fragment atomic coverage is optional and cumulative across frames; not a per-frame coverage oracle.
Vertex-stage writable storage was rejected by WebGPU validation. Current diagnostic uses fragment storage atomics instead.
Earlier first-frame-only input checks did not establish correctness of subsequent frames.
next_step: Compare font texture/palette bytes and sampled pixels after the FIFO transport fix; title and native controls remain unverified.
